note: What each feature Reel's recording shows, how to record it, and the evidence for what its posts claim. A recording runs against the local app on demo data only (FACTS.md 'Running the app locally for recording'). Recorded ones live in render/features/<id>.json and render/features/<id>/; for the rest, copy "spec" to render/features/<id>.json and run npm run record -- --id <id>. verify refuses a feature post whose recording is not listed here, and warns until it is recorded.

screens: /?range=30d: the group tiles, then the stores table; hold on stores 106 and 111 (labor over target)
/stores/store-106?range=30d: daily sales and labor % with the target line, then the store P&L
/labor: who is heading for overtime (names and hours, never pay), then the store table
/ledger, then one Daily sales entry: its lines and Balanced
/deposits: card days with no deposit first, then deposits with variances
/health: problems first, then the 14-day grid in words
/numbers?view=labor, ?view=prime_cost, ?view=tickets: tiles, chart, the by-store table with the change
/synopsis: the day's synopsis, Do first, findings worst first, one line per store
/ledger/close: Months to close; tap an LLC-month; its checklist (the seed closes no month)
/ledger/compare: every LLC by month (no bookkeeper report in the demo), then where the report lands
/statements?account=<Store 101 checking>: the Accounts card, then the account's register with every line booked to an account
/statements/reconcile?llc=entity-101: each account's balance in Rhea beside its statement's, the months marked reconciled
statements-reconcile.notes: The demo books its statements with merchant mappings only (no Claude reading), so no line shows "Booked by Rhea: check it"; the posts do not claim it. If the account link selector misses, tap the first account row by its text.

bills.notes: Never show Pay from Rhea or any payment form (test mode): the scene file's "avoid" list and the recorder's NEVER_IN_VIEW refuse any frame showing "Pay from Rhea", "Payments are sent by Stripe" or "Pay by card". A paid bill's page ends with its Payments card above Pay from Rhea; a bill waiting for approval shows Pay from Rhea on its first screen. If a bill page shows an email address the recorder stops: pick another bill.
